title: January 'whistle' event gets zero results; February whistle plus psionics gives first naked-eye UAP

tellings.quote: Hmm, let's move on to February. We spent event in January with equipment, but without" whistle ". And we got zero result.

plain: Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call in UFOs, says that a January 2025 session at its field site with all its equipment but without its "whistle" got zero results. According to the company, in February they added the whistle along with psionics, meaning mental or psychic techniques, and got their first sighting of an unidentified object with the naked eye. They tell it as their own experience, as a sign that the whistle and the mind make the difference.
